# Collapsible

A region of content that can be expanded and collapsed, forcing any adjacent content to be pushed down the page.
Make pages easier to scan by letting users reveal detailed information only if they need it.

Used by the <LinkTo kind="Components/Accordion" story="basic">Accordion</LinkTo> component.

<Source code="import { Collapsible } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />
